evidence.detail: The overlay visibility predicate returns true only when Client.cH == 60600, exactly the root built by R3 HalloweenEventChestInterface rs/n/c/N.

The overlay reads and renders exact widgets 60611, 60617, 60618, 60621 and 60625. Those same widgets are constructed by rs/n/c/N alongside exact 'Event Chest Tier I', 'Event Chest Tier II', 'Tier I - @yel@Halloween Event 2020', 'Roll', 'Exchange' and '@yel@Event Guide' presentation.

The overlay itself preserves exact event-tier messages including '<img=81> You must roll all the items from the previous tier! <img=81>', ' <img=81> Locked!', '<img=46> @gre@You've completed this tier of the event! <img=46>' and '@gre@Congratulations! You've completed the entire event!'.

The central rs/l/e/f overlay initialization constructs rs/l/e/a/h directly and registers it as a live overlay; the class extends the overlay base rs/l/e/f and renders only on the Halloween Event Chest root.

candidates.note: HalloweenEventChestOverlay is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the live overlay bound exclusively to root 60600 and the exact Halloween Event Chest widget/text surface. No original source identifier is claimed; confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers ScriptPacket ID 4 from rs/l/e/a/h.D; exact v308 initializes that field with concrete handler rs/l/e/a/i.

Selectors 1 through 4 write only rs/l/e/a/h state or the same 606xx Halloween Event Chest widgets. Selector 1 rebuilds the completed-tier map; selector 2 updates tier/progress values and widget 60625; selector 3 updates tier selection, 60617/60618/60621 sprites and item text derived from widget 60611; selector 4 toggles overlay state.
The target overlay is independently bound to Client.cH root 60600 and reads the same exact widgets built by HalloweenEventChestInterface.
The handler's ItemDefinition lookup in selector 3 is used only to format the selected event-chest item text stored back on rs/l/e/a/h; no unrelated Client subsystem is mutated.

candidates.note: HalloweenEventChestOverlayPacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 4. Its complete selector surface controls only the exact root-60600 Halloween Event Chest overlay; confidence is 0.998.
